gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: In 2018, Syndicate 1084 reported a release of GBP 35.2 million in technical reserves related to prior periods. This favorable development was predominantly observed in the Treaty, Energy, and Marine Divisions, attributed to better-than-expected claims experience on losses during 2018. The syndicate also noted significant catastrophe losses in 2018 from US windstorms Michael and Florence, typhoons Jebi and Trami, California wildfires, and the Ituango hydroelectric dam, with a net impact of GBP 57.3 million after reinsurance. Prior year (2017) catastrophe events, including Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria, Mexico earthquakes, and California wildfires, had a net impact of GBP 96.4 million.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and prior-year release amounts taken from the Technical Reserves and Movement in prior year's provision notes (explicit figures). Prior-year release is presented as a single aggregate (GBP 35.2m) and is not disaggregated by LOB; LOB attributions (Treaty, Energy, Marine) are stated qualitatively by the report and amounts per LOB are not provided. Named event amounts are reported as combined totals (gross and net) and not always allocated to specific single events; where group totals are given the gross figure is used for magnitude and net figure for net impact. Percentages are rounded to two decimal places. Confidence values reflect explicit statements (1.0) vs inferred or grouped allocations (0.8).
